overall: The AG found the Andover Board of Selectmen did not violate the Open Meeting Law: the July 11 minutes substantially complied with accuracy requirements, and no outside-meeting deliberation on the landfill project was shown.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the July 11 meeting minutes did not accurately or sufficiently detail a resident's comments about the Ledge Road Landfill.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the Board substantially complied with the requirement to provide an accurate and sufficiently detailed summary of the resident's statements about the Ledge Road Landfill.

allegations.summary: Complainant implied the Board deliberated on the Ledge Road Landfill closure project outside a noticed meeting between the May 2 Town Meeting and a June 23 consultant email.
allegations.key_passage: Because a quorum of the Board did not discuss the matter outside of a meeting during this timeframe, the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law in this regard.
